symptoms: Learners saw Module 3 before the prerequisite vocabulary card from Module 2.

The video captions said 'osmosis equalizes concentration' while the transcript and instructor correction said the sentence should be 'diffusion and osmosis move down gradients under different conditions'.
The quiz rubric awarded full credit for naming any membrane transport type, but the revised learning objective required comparing passive and active transport using evidence.
failed_assumption: The release owner assumed a green publish pipeline meant the learner-facing course was coherent.
business_impact: Forty-seven learners opened the lesson before the rollback. Nine support tickets referenced conflicting instructions between video, quiz, and LMS overview.
handoff_note: Do not write a one-off patch note. Capture the review workflow that would have caught this across future science, language, and professional-skills courses.
